title: Brand Identity & Visual Systems
short: Cohesive visual identities, distinctive marks, and rigorous brand guidelines.
description: I create comprehensive visual identities that articulate a brand's ethos with clarity and timeless elegance, from initial concept to full brand guidelines.
bestFor: Founders and creative teams seeking an enduring, bespoke brand presence.

title: Editorial & Publication Design
short: Thoughtfully crafted books, magazines, monographs, and annual reports.
description: Rooted in Swiss modernist grid traditions, I design editorial layouts where pacing, white space, and typography collaborate to tell compelling stories.
bestFor: Publishers, cultural organizations, and brands producing thoughtful print media.

title: Packaging & Structural Design
short: Tactile packaging, unboxing experiences, and sustainable production specs.
description: From primary labels to secondary cartons, I craft packaging experiences that command shelf presence and delight users during the unboxing ritual.
bestFor: Direct-to-consumer goods, specialty coffee, organic skincare, and boutique retail.

title: Digital Art Direction & Visual Systems
short: Translating physical craft and typographic sensibility into digital environments.
description: I translate brand ethos into screen spaces, establishing visual rhythm, layout systems, and photography art direction that feel authentic and elevated.
deliverables: Component styling & visual design in Figma
bestFor: Brands desiring a seamless aesthetic bridge between print collateral and digital touchpoints.

title: Typography & Custom Lettering
short: Custom typographic marks, headline lettering, and precise font pairings.
description: Typography is the foundation of graphic expression. I craft bespoke wordmarks, optical weight refinements, and harmonious multi-lingual typographic pairings.
bestFor: Campaigns, festivals, and publications requiring an unmistakable typographic voice.

title: Print Production & Material Craft
short: Paper stock selection, specialty finishes, press checks, and artisanal binding.
description: Great print design relies on tangible craftsmanship. I collaborate directly with master printers and paper merchants to ensure impeccable execution on the press.
deliverables: Pantone spot color separation & ink testing
bestFor: Agencies, studios, and luxury brands that demand flawless physical production quality.
